suppress.notes: Owner: dependency/CI maintenance. Scope: the exact shaded HttpCore 5.3.6 metadata inside docker-java-transport-zerodep 3.7.1 (SHA-1 6cb5345bd550735be72fd0ece15bd2ca1ed27595). This artifact is test scope only and is used exclusively by Testcontainers to communicate with the local, trusted Docker daemon over its named pipe. It is absent from production artifacts and never parses traffic from a remote or user-selected endpoint. CVE-2026-54399 and CVE-2026-54428 are remote resource-exhaustion issues in HTTP message parsing, so their attack precondition is not reachable in this deployment. Review or remove this temporary suppression by 2026-10-31, or earlier when Testcontainers/docker-java publishes a fixed zerodep transport.

Owner: dependency/CI maintenance. Scope: the exact shaded HttpClient 5.5.1 metadata inside docker-java-transport-zerodep 3.7.1 (SHA-1 65c367c5802c3ad030ef79fef924296d8e4990f4). This artifact is test scope only and is used exclusively by Testcontainers to communicate with the local, trusted Docker daemon over its named pipe. It is absent from production artifacts. CVE-2026-64607 requires a peer to return an invalid or unsupported Content-Encoding value and can then leak a test-process connection. That attack precondition is not reachable from an untrusted endpoint in this deployment. Review or remove this temporary suppression by 2026-10-31, or earlier when Testcontainers/docker-java publishes a fixed zerodep transport.

Owner: dependency/CI maintenance. Scope: the exact org.apache.tomcat.embed core, EL, Jasper, and WebSocket 11.0.24 artifacts selected by the pinned package-URL expression below. CVE-2026-66299 is confined to Tomcat's WebSocket chat example application; Apache states deployments without the examples application are not affected. The embedded JARs and the packaged Spring Boot application contain no Tomcat examples web application or websocket/chat classes, so the vulnerable code is absent. Dependency-Check matched the broad Tomcat CPE on the embedded JARs. Tomcat 11.0.25, the first listed fixed release, was not yet available from Maven Central on 2026-08-11. Review and remove this suppression as soon as 11.0.25 is released, and no later than 2026-09-30.

Owner: dependency/CI maintenance. CVEs: N/A; this rule removes only a false-positive PostgreSQL server CPE. Scope: the exact Flyway PostgreSQL database-support module org.flywaydb:flyway-database-postgresql:12.4.0. Dependency-Check has misidentified this JDBC support library as PostgreSQL server 12.4.0. The module does not embed or distribute the PostgreSQL server, so server CVEs derived solely from that CPE do not apply. The package URL and erroneous CPE are both pinned; review this rule when Flyway is upgraded.
